result.finding: Assessed 5 CWE rules in Credentials & Secrets: 0 FOUND, 5 NOT_FOUND
evidence: Inspected credential references throughout production source, .env.example, database startup scripts, Docker/Compose, application properties and setup documentation without persisting secret values. Runtime passwords are external required environment settings; .env.example values are marked replaceable placeholders, not embedded authentication constants. BCrypt encodes the externally supplied admin password. No hard-coded cryptographic key identified. Database initialization grants schema-level privileges and no DBA grant; public gallery is explicitly intended, while state-changing routes require authentication. Service/controller logs record upload rejection, creation, deletion and exceptions. Deployment filesystem permissions, external log collection and authentication-failure audit retention were not runtime-verified; no generic insufficiency finding inferred solely from absence of a custom logger.

values.name: Use of Hard-coded Password
values.description: The product contains a hard-coded password, which it uses for its own inbound authentication or for outbound communication to external components.

values.name: Use of Hard-coded Cryptographic Key
values.description: The product uses a hard-coded, unchangeable cryptographic key.

values.name: Incorrect Permission Assignment for Critical Resource
values.description: The product specifies permissions for a security-critical resource in a way that allows that resource to be read or modified by unintended actors.

values.name: Insufficient Logging
values.description: When a security-critical event occurs, the product either does not record the event or omits important details about the event when logging it.

values.name: Use of Hard-coded Credentials
values.description: The product contains hard-coded credentials, such as a password or cryptographic key.
